6.  THE SECOND "GOVERNMENT," HEADED BY BAKHTIAR'S CLOSE
FRIEND MEHDI BAZARGAN, HAS YET TO TAKE SHAPE.  BAZARGAN
FINDS HIMSELF RELUCTANTLY IN THE POSITION OF CHALLENGING
BAKHTIAR, FEARS AN OPEN CONFLICT WITH THE ARMED FORCES,
AND WOULD DEARLY LOVE TO FIND SOME POLITICAL COMPROMISE
WITH BAKHTIAR WHICH WOULD PERMIT A PEACEFUL RESOLUTION OF
THE IMPASSE.

7.  HOWEVER, AS A DEVOUT SHI'ITE, WHO SHOWS TOTAL DEFERENCE
TO THE AUTHORITY OF THE SHI'A CLERGY,BAZARGAN HAS ACCEPTED
THE DUTY THRUST ON HIM BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND WILL
DOUBTLESS GO THROUGH WITH HIS ASSIGNMENT OF FORMING A
GOVERNMENT AND ATTEMPTING TO MOVE IRAN TOWARDS THE GOAL
OF BECOMING AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

16.  IN ASSESSING THE ACTIONS WHICH KHOMEINI TOOK
FEBRUARY 5, THERE ARE SOME FAINT REASONS TO SUSTAIN THE
HOPE.  FIRST, HE NAMED BAZARGAN, A KNOWN MODERATE, TO BE
"PROVISIONAL PRIME MINISTER."  SECOND, HE REFRAINED FROM
NAMING OTHER MEMBERS OF A "GOVERNMENT."  THIRD, HE ASSERTED
THAT THE 1906 CONSTITUTION REMAINS VALID.  FOURTH, HE
INDICATED SOME VAGUE ACCEPTANCE OF DEMOCRATIC METHODS TO
ESTABLISH THE LEGITIMACY OF ANY CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE.

1.  (S - ENTIRE TEXT).
2.  A FEW DAYS AGO, I REPORTED MY VIEW THAT EVENTS IN
IRAN HAD BECOME UNPREDICTABLE.  WHILE THAT IS STILL MY
VIEW, I SHALL ATTEMPT, IN THIS CABLE, TO SET OUT SOME OF
THE CONTINGENT POSSIBILITIES INHERENT IN THE CURRENT
SITUATION.
3.  FIRST, WE SHOULD DESCRIBE THE SITUATION.  IRAN HAS
TWO RIVAL "GOVERNMENTS."  THAT WHICH IS HEADED BY DR.
BAKHTIAR HAS THE FIRMAN OF THE SHAH,  THE SANCTION OF A
REGENCY COUNCIL AND THE APPROVAL OF PARLIAMENT.  IT
COMMANDS THE SUPPORT OF THE ARMED FORCES AND IS DEALT
WITH BY ALL FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS AS THE LEGITIMATE
GOVERNMENT OF IRAN.
4.  HOWEVER, THE BUREAUCRACY DOES NOT WORK FOR IT, THE
NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL COMPANY OPERATES (IN A LIMITED WAY)
INDEPENDENT OF IT, AND IT HAS NO REVENUES.  THE PRIVATE
ECONOMIC SECTOR, WHICH IS AT A STANDSTILL, IGNORES IT
AND OCCASIONALLY DEFIES IT.
5.  THERE IS AN INCREASING NUMBER OF IRANIANS, PARTICULAR-
LY AMONG THE INTELLECTUALS, WHO ADMIRE BAKHTIAR'S SPUNK,
WHO SHARE HIS LIBERAL DEMOCRATIC HOPES FOR IRAN'S FUTURE,
AND WHO WISH HIM WELL.  BUT THEY ARE TIMID, POORLY
ORGANIZED AND UNWILLING TO RISK THEIR LIVES OR FORTUNES
TO SUPPORT BAKHTIAR.
6.  THE SECOND "GOVERNMENT," HEADED BY BAKHTIAR'S CLOSE
FRIEND MEHDI BAZARGAN, HAS YET TO TAKE SHAPE.  BAZARGAN
FINDS HIMSELF RELUCTANTLY IN THE POSITION OF CHALLENGING
BAKHTIAR, FEARS AN OPEN CONFLICT WITH THE ARMED FORCES,
AND WOULD DEARLY LOVE TO FIND SOME POLITICAL COMPROMISE
WITH BAKHTIAR WHICH WOULD PERMIT A PEACEFUL RESOLUTION OF
THE IMPASSE.
7.  HOWEVER, AS A DEVOUT SHI'ITE, WHO SHOWS TOTAL DEFERENCE
TO THE AUTHORITY OF THE SHI'A CLERGY,BAZARGAN HAS ACCEPTED
THE DUTY THRUST ON HIM BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND WILL
DOUBTLESS GO THROUGH WITH HIS ASSIGNMENT OF FORMING A
GOVERNMENT AND ATTEMPTING TO MOVE IRAN TOWARDS THE GOAL
OF BECOMING AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.
8.  BAZARGAN, IN CONTRAST TO BAKHTIAR, CAN PROBABLY INDUCE
THE BUREAUCRACY TO FUNCTION, THE NIOC TO PRODUCE, AND
PRIVATE BUSINESS ENTERPRISE TO RESUME MORE OR LESS NORMAL
ACTIVITY.  HE CAN DO ALL THIS IN THE NAME OF AYATOLLAH
KHOMEINI AND HIS "MOVEMENT."  BUT, HE CANNOT RPT NOT GET
HIS MINISTERS TO ENTER A GOVERNMENT BUILDING WITHOUT BEING
CHALLENGED AND PROBABLY ARRESTED BY THE ARMED FORCES,
ACTING UNDER ORDERS FROM BAKHTIAR.
9.  THE LEADERS OF THESE TWO "GOVERNMENTS" HAVE MUCH IN
COMMON BESIDES THEIR PERSONAL FRIENDSHIP.  THEY BOTH ARE
PREPARED TO PLACE THE DECISIONS ABOUT THE FUTURE OF IRAN
IN THE HANDS OF A DEMOCRATIC DECISION BY THE IRANIAN
PEOPLE,PREFERABLY THROUGH FREE ELECTIONS TO A PARLIAMENTARY
BODY WHICH WOULD FUNCTION AS A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY.
NEITHER ONE WILL ACCEPT THE OTHER AS THE LEGITIMATE AGENCY
TO ORGANIZE AND SUPERVISE THOSE ELECTIONS, BUT, LEFT TO
THEIR OWN DEVICES THE TWO OLD FRIENDS COULD PROBABLY AGREE
UPON A NEUTRAL, AUTONOMOUS ORGAN WHICH WOULD BE ACCORDED
THAT TASK BY BOTH "GOVERNMENTS."
10.  THEREFORE, IN THE BEST OF ALL POSSIBLE WORLDS, THERE
WOULD BE REASON TO HOPE THAT A CIVILIZED POLITICAL SOLU-
TION TO THE CURRENT IMPASSE WILL BE FOUND AND THAT IRAN
WILL MOVE AWAY FROM THE BRINK OF CIVIL WAR.  ALL OF US
LIVING IN THIS COUNTRY HAVE TO NOURISH OUR DAILY EXISTENCE
WITH THE ENHANCEMENT OF THIS HOPE.
11.  ON THE OTHER HAND, THERE ARE SIGNIFICANT FORCES WORK-
ING AGAINST SUCH A PEACEFUL DENOUEMENT.  THE FIRST OF THESE
IS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND THE MORE AMBITIOUS MEMBERS OF
HIS ENTOURAGE.  THEY REALIZE THAT THE "REVOLUTION" THEY
HAVE WON IN THE STREETS COULD BE LOST UNLESS THEY MOVE TO
CAPITALIZE ON THEIR SUCCESSES IMMEDIATELY.  THEY THEREFORE
SEEM PREPARED TO PRESS MORE VIGOROUSLY THAN BAZARGAN DEEMS
PRUDENT IN ORDER TO STAMPEDE THE NATION TOWARDS AN ISLAMIC
REPUBLIC WITHOUT BENEFIT OF DEMOCRATIC PROCESSES.  THEY
CLAIM TO BELIEVE THE ARMED FORCES WILL NOT RPT NOT OPPOSE
THEM AND THAT A BOLD POLICY WILL ACHIEVE ITS OWN REWARDS.
------------------073503  061517Z /42
FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN
TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3796
S E C R E T SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01870
EXDIS
12.  MORE STRIDENT, AND MORE DANGEROUS, THAN THE AYATOLLAH'S
MEN ARE THE ARMED RADICALS AND TERRORISTS WHO SUPPORT THEM
AND WHO EXERT GREAT PRESSURE ON THEIR LEADERSHIP.  THESE
MUJAHEDIN ARE TRAINED BY PLO AND OTHER RADICAL ISLAMIC
GROUPS WHO ARE FANATICALLY DEVOTED TO THE GOALS OF CONVERT-
ING IRAN INTO A LEADING STATE IN THE CAUSE OF DARUL ISLAM.
THEY CAN LEAD AND STIR UP THE STREET MOBS, WHO, IN THEIR
MOST EXTREME FORM, ARE A FORMIDABLE CHALLENGE TO THE
ARMED FORCES.
13.  BEYOND THEM ARE THE MARXIST FORCES, PARTICULARLY THE
TUDEH PARTY, WHICH OPERATES UNDER MOSCOW'S CONTROL, AND
WHICH FUNCTION TO GOAD THE RELIGIOUS AND ARMED FORCES
INTO CONFLICT WITH EACH OTHER.  THESE PEOPLE ARE ALSO
ARMED BUT OPERATE WITH MORE SOPHISTICATION AND LESS
FANATICISM THAN THE MUJAHEDIN.
14.  ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE EQUATION, THERE ARE ALSO
FORCES OPERATING AGAINST THE RATIONAL SOLUTIONS FAVORED
BY BAKHTIAR AND BARZAGAN.  THESE CONSIST PRIMARILY OF DIE-
HARD SUPPORTERS OF THE SHAH, AS WELL AS SOME OPPORTUNISTS
IN THE ARMED FORCES.  ARDESHIR ZAHEDI IS AN EXAMPLE OF
THIS BREED, AS WELL AS MILITARY OFFICERS SUCH AS MANOUCHER
KHOSROWDAD.  THEIR LOYALTY TO BAKHTIAR IS MINIMAL AND THEY
WOULD RATHER DESTROY HIM THAN SEE HIM REACH AN ACCOMMODA-
TION WHICH MIGHT RESULT IN THE ABOLITION OF THE MONARCHY.
15.  HENCE, THE HOPES FOR A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT ARE
FRAGILE AND COULD BE DESTROYED BY ANY NUMBER OF FORCES
WHICH ARE ANTAGONISTIC TO SUCH A SETTLEMENT.  IF THESE
FORCES SUCCEED IN FRUSTRATING THOSE HOPES, THE CONSEQUENCES
AGAIN ARE UNPREDICTABLE.  HOWEVER, IT SEEMS PROBABLE THEY
WOULD BE VIOLENT AND COULD ENTAIL EVERYTHING FROM INCREASED
TERRORISM TO OUTRIGHT CIVIL WAR.
16.  IN ASSESSING THE ACTIONS WHICH KHOMEINI TOOK
FEBRUARY 5, THERE ARE SOME FAINT REASONS TO SUSTAIN THE
HOPE.  FIRST, HE NAMED BAZARGAN, A KNOWN MODERATE, TO BE
"PROVISIONAL PRIME MINISTER."  SECOND, HE REFRAINED FROM
NAMING OTHER MEMBERS OF A "GOVERNMENT."  THIRD, HE ASSERTED
THAT THE 1906 CONSTITUTION REMAINS VALID.  FOURTH, HE
INDICATED SOME VAGUE ACCEPTANCE OF DEMOCRATIC METHODS TO
ESTABLISH THE LEGITIMACY OF ANY CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE.
17.  IT NOW REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER BAZARGAN AND BAKHTIAR
WILL BE GIVEN A CHANCE TO FOLLOW THEIR NATURAL INSTINCTS OR
WHETHER THEY WILL BE MANEUVERED BY OTHERS INTO A CONFLICT
EACH OF THEM WISHES TO AVOID.  SULLIVAN
